name: 2018 Topps WWE Hall of Fame Tribute Ultimate Warrior Checklist: All Wrestling

cards.p: Defeats Honky Tonk Man for the Intercontinental Championship
Defeats 'Ravishing' Rick Rude for his Second Intercontinental Championship
Defeats The Heenan Family at Survivor Series 1989
Wins the WWE Championship at WrestleMania VI
Defeats 'Ravishing' Rick Rude at SummerSlam 1990 in a Steel Cage Match
Wins the Grand Finale Match of Survival at Survivor Series 1990
Returns to WWE, Defeating Hunter Hearst Helmsley at WrestleMania XII
Joins WCW to take on the nWo
Enters the WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2014

sections.title: Retires Macho King Randy Savage At Wrestlemania VII
